skill.name: thinking-partner
skill.description: Guides users through a five-stage conversation to clarify problems, identify root causes, co-create solutions, and plan action.
skill.summary: Structured thinking partner for clarifying complex decisions and turning insight into action.
skill.author: yunshu0909

security_audit.summary: Both static findings were reviewed against SKILL.md. The external command alert is a Markdown code fence around a workflow diagram, and the entropy alert reflects readable Chinese Markdown content rather than obfuscation.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (7.50 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md lines 33-35 contain a Markdown fenced workflow diagram, not Ruby backtick execution or a shell command. No command is invoked and no user input reaches execution.

SKILL.md is readable Markdown with Chinese instructions and YAML front matter; line 1 begins the front matter delimiter. The high entropy heuristic is consistent with multilingual UTF-8 text, not binary or encrypted content.

content.user_title: Clarify Problems With a Thinking Partner
content.value_statement: Complex decisions often feel unclear because many issues compete for attention. This skill uses structured dialogue to find the core problem, explore root causes, and create a practical next step.
actual_capabilities: Helps separate the core problem from secondary issues.
Challenges new information by weighing signal against noise.
Guides root cause exploration with follow-up questions.
Turns agreed solutions into focused action plans.
limitations: Requires the user to share enough context.
Does not replace professional therapy, legal, medical, or financial advice.
May be slower than direct answer skills because it follows staged dialogue.
Source instructions are written in Chinese, so translation depends on the host model.

use_cases.title: Clarify a Work Decision
use_cases.description: Explore competing priorities, identify the real constraint, and leave with a clear next action.

use_cases.title: Unblock a Creator Project
use_cases.description: Sort creative doubts, separate useful signals from noise, and choose the next focused move.

use_cases.title: Plan a Team Discussion
use_cases.description: Frame the core issue before a meeting so discussion stays focused and actionable.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Problem Review
prompt_templates.prompt: I feel stuck on a decision. Ask me questions first, then help me identify the core problem before suggesting action.

prompt_templates.title: Sort Competing Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Here are several things going wrong: [list]. Help me group them, separate signal from noise, and choose the core issue.

prompt_templates.title: Challenge My Assumption
prompt_templates.prompt: I think the main problem is [assumption]. Test this with me using evidence from my situation before we choose a direction.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Action Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: We identified the root cause as [root cause]. Help me co-create one or two solutions and turn them into a focused plan.

output_examples.input: I cannot decide whether to change jobs.
output_examples.output: The skill asks about goals, constraints, attempts, and risks before naming the core decision.

output_examples.input: My project has too many problems.
output_examples.output: The response groups issues, identifies the highest-leverage constraint, and explains which details are secondary.

output_examples.input: We found the root cause, but I need a plan.
output_examples.output: The skill drafts a short plan with actions, priorities, and items to avoid.

best_practices: Share concrete context, including goals, constraints, and prior attempts.
Confirm or challenge each stage before moving forward.
Use the final plan as a short commitment, not a full project schedule.
anti_patterns: Demanding instant advice before the context stage is complete.
Treating every new detail as equally important.
Using the skill for regulated professional advice without expert review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps users clarify complex situations through context gathering, core problem selection, root cause analysis, solution discussion, and action planning.

faq.question: Does it give direct advice?
faq.answer: It can suggest ideas, but it first asks questions and helps the user reason through the issue.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help a team lead frame the central issue before a focused discussion.

faq.question: What language is the source prompt written in?
faq.answer: The source instructions are written in Chinese.

faq.question: Can it replace professional advice?
faq.answer: No. Users should consult qualified experts for legal, medical, financial, or mental health decisions.
